Titles.jpn: デジモンフロンティア

Summaries.eng: Takuya, Kouji, Izumi, Junpei. and Tomoki meet each other on a train that takes them to the Digital World where a war against evil is being fought. The Angel digimon, Cherubimon, one of the three angels sent to save the world from the power-hungry Lucemon, has turned to the dark side and the entire Digital World is in peril. To fight this great battle, the five CHOSEN ONES must find the Densetsu no Spirit (Legendary Spirit).

Titles.eng: Digimon Frontier: Regeneration of Ancient Digimon
Titles.jpn: デジモンフロンティア 古代デジモン復活!!

Summaries.eng: The five digi-destined children stumble upon an ancient island inhabited by two different types of digimon; The Beast types, and the Human types. When they see two young digimon-a beast and humanoid-have become friends, they decide something must be done about the feud.

Summaries.kor:
휴대전화 건너 정체불명의 목소리에 이끌려 디지털 세계에 오게 된 다섯 명 아이들!! 이들은 과거 디지털 세계를 구한 전설의 열 명의 용사가 남긴 스피릿을 찾아낸다. 스피릿을 디지바이스에 저장하고 디스캐너로 스캔하면 디지몬으로 진화한다!! 여기서 이전과는 다른 설정이 눈에 띈다. 디지몬 3번째 시리즈까지는 선택받은 아이들과 파트너 디지몬이 등장했다. 디지몬 테이머즈에서는 스피릿과 디스캐너로 인간 자신이 디지몬으로 변화한다. 어렸을 때 이 작품을 본 사람이라면 알 것이다 그 유명한 말을. ‘스피릿 에볼루션’!!
5명의 아이들이 디지털 세계의 평화를 위해 디지몬과 싸운다!
Summaries.zhtw: 很久以前，數碼世界中的主力人型和獸型數碼暴龍發生衝突，光明獸調停了這次衝突並成為數碼世界的統治者，後來他變得殘暴，不斷虐待他的子民，這時出現了傳說中的十鬥士，打敗並封印了光明獸。然而，十鬥士消失了並化為戰魂，受三大天使掌管。此後數碼世界在三大天使的管治下得到和平。 可是有一天，數碼世界出現了新的黑暗勢力，三大天使之一基路比獸受邪氣感染，很多數碼暴龍被基路比獸傳染而變得殘暴，不斷吞食數碼世界。數碼世界有十個戰魂，歸於三大天使，究極天使獸、神聖天女獸和基路比獸，作為三大天使擁有了其中五個鬥士（土、水、木、鋼和暗），他們也變成了邪惡鬥士、並四處破壞；現實世界有許多小朋友收到了來自數碼世界的求救訊息、踏入數碼世界。

Titles.jpn: 伝説の闘士！炎のアグニモン

Summaries.eng: Kids across the city get strange messages on their electronic devices. These messages ask them if they're ready for their future. What do these messages mean?

Titles.jpn: 光のヴォルフモン 地下迷宮の戦い！

Summaries.eng: With one spirit down, the others prepare for their destiny's, but how does one spirit evolve? Does this mean all the kids will become legendary warriors? And how does spirit evolution work?

Titles.jpn: いじめは許さない！氷のチャックモン進化

Summaries.eng: Tomoki wants to learn to spirit evolve, but to get a spirit, he must get through a Candmon village. Can Agnimon help save the day?

Titles.jpn: 私のキックは痛いわよ！女闘士フェアリモン

Summaries.eng: Zoe, JP, Tommy, and Takuya reach a spliting point on the Trailmon tracks. When Takuya and Tommy go one way, it's up to JP and Zoe to save a bunch of Floramon. Can they do so when neither of them has a spirit?

Titles.jpn: 大地を揺るがす雷パワー ブリッツモン！

Summaries.eng: The new digidestined must help a village of Digimon to get free from the Goblimon and Snimon, but can they do so when JP doesn't have a spirit?

Titles.eng: A Molehill Out of a Mountain
Titles.jpn: 伝説の５闘士VS新たなる闘士！

Summaries.eng: The KarautsukiNumemon look for help for their village because legendary warriors have taken their womon and childmon hostage, but when they find out the gang is legendary warriors trouble is the result. What exactly is a Beast Spirit, and why is their now a slide evolution? The answers can be found.

Titles.jpn: 空に浮かぶ街！トイアグモンのおもちゃの国

Summaries.eng: Takuya's and Koji's differences cause a lot of arguements, but when Tommy gets captured, can they put aside their differences and save him?

Titles.jpn: みんなを救え！進化するんだツノモン

Summaries.eng: JP and Zoe arrive at a digimon school where one digimon, Tsunomon, is constantly being ignored. Can the two of them convience the other kids that digivolution isn't a bad thing?

Titles.jpn: 敵はチャックモン!?謎のテレビの森

Summaries.eng: Tommy is tricked by a Bakumon causing his dreams to all be evil and make his friends appear evil. Can the digi-destined find a way to save him?

Titles.jpn: ビーストスピリットは制御不能!?ガルムモン進化！

Summaries.eng: The digi-destined figure out that you need a Beast Spirit to defeat a Beast Spirit, but can they find there Beast Spirits before Grumblemon steals all of their spirits?

Titles.jpn: 俺を倒せ！伝説の闘士ヴリトラモン暴走

Summaries.eng: When Grottemon isolates koji, the others must find a way to defeat his Beast Spirit. Can Shamamon help them out when he's possessed?

Titles.eng: Fear and Loathing in Los Arboles
Titles.jpn: ほえろヴリトラモン！倒せギガスモン！

Summaries.eng: Takuya gains control over his beast spirit, but can he maintain that control when he's forced into a one-on-one battle with Grumblemon?

Titles.eng: Better An Egg Than An Egg Shell
Titles.jpn: 目覚めよセラフィモン！十闘士の秘密！

Summaries.eng: 4 of the 5 Dark Warriors decide to attack the digi-destined on a quest to gain their spirits. Can a little help from Sorcermon and Seraphimon help them to free the digital world?

Titles.jpn: 雷よ！岩をも砕け！ボルグモン決死のチャレンジ

Summaries.eng: Grumblemon returns to regain his beast spirit and seperates Takuya and Koji from the rest of the group, but when JP gains his beast spirit can he master it enough to finish off Grumblemon for good?

Titles.jpn: イカしたビースト進化！カルマーラモン

Summaries.eng: When the gang decodes to go on a water vacation, the Toucanmon steal the boys D-tectors. Can Zoe save the day without her beast spirit?

Titles.jpn: 強いだけじゃダメなのよ！美しき闘士シューツモン

Summaries.eng: A group of Gomamon want to gain access to their island, but it's surronded by whirlpools and Zephrymon guards the way. Can the digi-destined find a way to save the world when the boys still don't have their D-tectors?

Titles.jpn: ブリザーモン 吹けよ雪、呼べよ氷河！

Summaries.eng: Tommy finds the boys D-Tectors at the county fair, but he doesn't have anything to trade to get them back. Can he find something to trade to get them back before the Dark Legendary Warriors show up?

Titles.jpn: チキチキ！トレイルモン猛レース

Summaries.eng: The digi-destined stop their battles briefly to participate in the Trailmon races, but can they find a way to stop the normal cheating that occurs?

Titles.jpn: バーガモンを救え！友樹のピュアな心

Summaries.eng: The kids need some food, so they head to the Burgermon village. What will happen when they run into the master of wood?

Titles.jpn: 闇にひそむ謎の闘士 ダスクモン！

Summaries.eng: Arbormon wants revenge for his missing burgers, so he follows the kids into The Continent of Darkness, but what else has followed there?

Titles.jpn: 五闘士全滅!?恐るべき闇のパワー！

Summaries.eng: When Duskmon proves to be too strong for the digi-destined, they have a new decision to make. What will it be?

Titles.jpn: 我が家へ！拓也たった一人の帰還

Summaries.eng: Takuya decides to head home on a Dark Trailmon, but when he gets stuck as a Digimon in the real world, what will he do?

Titles.jpn: 感じろデジモンの力！拓也渾身の作戦

Summaries.eng: Takuya returns to the digital world as a stronger Agunimon, but can he save his friends in a classic 2-on-1 showdown?

Titles.jpn: 対決ボルケーモン！純平、過去との激闘

Summaries.eng: When the kids get sucked inside Sakkakumon, they must defeat their opponents and their own self doubts to get free, but will they succeed?

Titles.jpn: 友樹の孤独な戦い アシュラモンの罠

Summaries.eng: Tommy gets a group of digimon in his dimension who pretend to be his friend, but can he figure out the truth before they steal his D-Tector?

Titles.jpn: ラーナモンの執念！女デジモン一騎撃ち

Summaries.eng: The fight between Ranamon and Zoe reaches its exciting finale, but who will come out the victor?

Titles.jpn: 奇跡のダブルスピリット！ベオウルフモン誕生

Summaries.eng: Koji must battle Duskmon one on one, but will he be able to succeed when they couldn't defeat Duskmon as a team?

Titles.jpn: 拓也の融合進化 アルダモン技炸裂！

Summaries.eng: To get out of Sakkakumon, Takuya must find a way to defeat Mercurymon. Can he find a way to achieve Fusion Evolution and succeed, or are the digi-destined done for in this battle?

Titles.jpn: 逃走！変幻自在セフィロトモン

Summaries.eng: Sakkakumon reveals he is still alive, and now he has the digi-destined's attacks. Can they find a way to create new attacks and defeat Sakkakumon once and for all?

Titles.jpn: 飛翔！闇の闘士ベルグモン

Summaries.eng: Koji and Kouichi begin to figure out they're related some how, but what is that relation, and can it stop the two of them from destroying each other?

Titles.jpn: 闇に眠る トレイルモンの墓場

Summaries.eng: JP, Zoe, and Tommy decide to discover what horrors await them at the Rose Morning Star by searching a Trailmon graveyard, but what horrors await them inside the graveyard?

Titles.jpn: 明かされた過去！ダスクモンの秘密

Summaries.eng: When Koji realizes he has a brother and has been fighting him, he refuses to fight anymore. Can Takuya make him see the truth?

Titles.jpn: 新たなる闇の闘士！レーベモン＆カイザーレオモン

Summaries.eng: Now that he's a regular human again, Kouichi decides to join the digi-destined, but can he find a way to help them out without any spirits of his own to use?

Titles.jpn: 決戦！バラの明星 オファニモン救出作戦

Summaries.eng: The digidestined decide to free Ophanimon once and for all, but Cherubimon ends up being her guard. Can they find a way to free her from the final of the 3 guardian Digimon?

Titles.jpn: スピリットを一つに！拓也と輝二の究極進化

Summaries.eng: Takuya and Koji must hold off Cherubimon while the others free Ophanimon, but can they succeed when they lose their spirits?

Titles.jpn: 勝利への飛翔！対決ケルビモンの城

Summaries.eng: Cherubimon appears to be defeated, but he appears to be easy compared to IceDevimon. Can the others find a way to defeat IceDevimon with Takuya and Koji's D-Tectors frozen solid?

Titles.jpn: 決戦！命ある限り デジタルワールドを取り戻せ

Summaries.eng: The final battle between EmperorGreymon/ MagnaGarurumon and Cherubimon begins, but who will end up being the victor, and who are these mysterious characters that are watching the battle?

Titles.jpn: 終わらない死闘！ルーチェモン復活の序曲

Summaries.eng: The Royal Knights appears and reveal that Lucemon will return. Can the digi-destined find a way to prevent this chaos from occuring,or will they be delaying the inevitable?

Titles.eng: The Man in the Moon Is You
Titles.jpn: これがデジタルワールド!?月からの脱出！

Summaries.eng: After waking up on the moon, the digi-destined decide to try to get back to the digital world to get revenge on the Royal Knights, but will they succeed, or will they be stuck on the moon for the rest of their lives?

Titles.jpn: 選ばれし者!?エンジェモンを操る少年！

Summaries.eng: The digidestined run into the same group of kids that pushed Tommy onto the train causing him to come into the digital world, but can Tommy get past his resentment of them and save the day?

Titles.jpn: スキャンさせるな！友情の豆の木

Summaries.eng: Katshuhara and company have been captured by the Royal Knights. It's a good thing for them that Tommy is with them, but can they find a way to save Beanstalk Village, and can the other kids get Worm the Trailmon to want to help out?

Titles.jpn: デジタマを守れ！消えゆく命の奇跡

Summaries.eng: When the Royal Knights target the Village og Beginnings for their next assault, it's up to the kids to convience the Trailmon to save the digi-eggs, but can they finally defeat the Royal Knights? Maybe they can with help from some old enemies.

Titles.jpn: 故郷消滅！地獄の使者スカルサタモン

Summaries.eng: The kids rush to try and save the Flame Terminal from being deleted, but with the SkullSatamon already on hand, can they find a way to defeat them? Is there any way to unite all the Digimon to fight together?

Titles.eng: Now You See It, Now You Don't
Titles.jpn: 共に戦え！ゴツモンと輝二の誓い

Summaries.eng: With only 3 areas left to protect in the digital world, the digi-destined must act fast to save the forest terminal. EmperorGreymon and MagnaGarurumon seem to be getting stronger, but will they finally be able to defeat the Royal Knights?

Titles.eng: All Aboard The Tag Team Express
Titles.jpn: データかく乱作戦！アキバマーケットを防衛せよ

Summaries.eng: Only 2 areas of the digital world remain: The Autumn Leaf Fair and Ophanimon's castle, but can the kids find a way to save The Fair without losing any more digimon friends, or is the digital world truly done for?

Titles.eng: To Make The World Go Away
Titles.jpn: デジタルワールド消滅!?ルーチェモン暗黒支配

Summaries.eng: The digi-destined arrive at Ophanimon's castle to try and save the last bit of data from being given to Lucemon. Can they finally defeat the Royal Knights, or will Lucemon be reborn?

Titles.jpn: ロイヤルナイツ散る そして…!!

Summaries.eng: The final battle with the Royal Knights is about to occur, but who will win this surprising bout?

Titles.jpn: 光と闇を一つに！輝一最後の願い

Summaries.eng: Since Emperor Greymon and MagnaGarurumon proved to be too weak, the kids decide to try a multi attack, but will it be enough, or will they need additional power?

Titles.jpn: 戦えスサノオモン ルーチェモン人間界到達!!

Summaries.eng: Susannomon has been born, but will the combined powers of all 10 legendary spirits be enough to defeat Lucemon for good, or does Lucemon have one final surprise in store?

Titles.jpn: 時を越えて！新たな伝説の始まり

Summaries.eng: The final battle between Lucemon and Susanoomon will be decided not in the digital world, but in the real world. Who will end up prevailing in this free for all?
